integrity.computational_evidence: Exhaustive exact modular ranks at cyclic orders six and twenty-one, with cyclotomic norm lifting and affine orbit enumeration

scientific_limitations: Rank at least three is not further resolved in general; no higher-order or singular-value classification. The semiprime incidence formula concerns four-point restrictions at 3p for primes p>=5. Historical equivalence remains possible in unindexed or inaccessible sources.
title: Rank-two coset rigidity for finite Fourier restrictions and a semiprime incidence law
